Give it one month. See, children find English difficult because they are taught in a boring way. Grammar rules, rote learning, punishment—children don't learn from this, they get scared. Download the English Seekho App, open the General English Show. The first video is 'Start conversation with Hello'. More than one lakh people have watched it. It is explained in Hindi, so simple that the child will understand on their own. Then show the child English words for good manners: Please, Thank You, Sorry, Excuse me. These are small words, but the child's confidence will come from here. Then daily ten easy sentences, daily simple sentences that the child will repeat, and practice will be with me. I am an AI coach. The child will talk to me in English. If they speak incorrectly, I will correct them with love. If they make mistakes 500 times, I will correct them 500 times. I will never scold, never laugh. The best part is you can also learn along. Watch the 'Introduce your family' video together. Make a game of mother-son English practice—bonding as well as learning. What will happen in one month? The child will start speaking English. Not perfect, but without fear, without shyness, and you will feel proud. Download the English Seekho App, open the General English Show, start with Hello. Start this today with your child.]
Speaker B: Install Now पे क्लिक करो और अभी English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [Click on Install Now and download the English Seekho app now.]
